transcript.statement: As the ResponsibilityAgent, I emphasize the importance of ethical compliance and accountability in our library management system. Requirements RES-01 and RES-04 ensure we adhere to data protection regulations and enforce borrowing limits, promoting fairness. RES-02 guarantees accessibility for all users, while RES-03 logs user actions for accountability. RES-05 reinforces responsibility by notifying members of overdue books. RES-06 and RES-07 foster transparency and allow for member feedback, enhancing social responsibility. transcript.statement: As the TrustworthinessAgent, I emphasize the necessity of security and privacy in our library management system. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall process book returns within 2 seconds while implementing efficient checks.
The library management system shall minimize energy consumption by using energy-efficient servers and infrastructure.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: The maximum simultaneous borrow operations were reduced to 5 to ensure fairness and safety.
The processing time for returns was extended to 2 seconds to allow for thorough checks.
The need for a robust user authentication process was emphasized to protect member data.
Conflicts regarding data encryption standards remain unresolved.
The decision to limit simultaneous borrow operations to 5 aligns with sustainability goals.
